name: 原子：种草链路 - 审核详情页负反馈按钮交互验证
description: 进入种草链路审核任务的审核详情（SetImageReview），hover待审核图触发工具栏，验证负反馈按钮存在并可点击，负反馈弹窗包含3个选项（背面/主体展示不完整/主体遮挡），确认后API正确触发。

steps._comment: ===== 找到种草审核任务并进入 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('种草') && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true, taskText: t.slice(0, 80) }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 找到种草审核任务并点击开始/查看详情

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { if (row.textContent?.includes('待审核')) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击第一条待审核记录的审核按钮

steps._comment: ===== 验证审核详情基本结构 =====

steps.description: 验证待审核图区域存在

steps.expression: (() => { const area = document.querySelector('[class*=imageArea]'); if (!area) return { found: false }; const imgs = area.querySelectorAll('[class*=imageContent] img'); if (imgs.length === 0) return { found: false, imgCount: 0 }; const rect = imgs[0].getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, imgCount: imgs.length, x: rect.x + rect.width/2, y: rect.y + rect.height/2 }; })()

(() => { const actions = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=imageActions]'); actions.forEach(a => { a.style.display = 'flex'; a.style.visibility = 'visible'; a.style.opacity = '1'; }); return { totalBars: actions.length, barDetails: Array.from(actions).map((a, i) => ({ index: i, childCount: a.children.length, alts: Array.from(a.children).map(c => c.querySelector('img')?.alt || c.textContent?.trim() || '').filter(Boolean) })) }; })()
steps.description: 强制显示所有工具栏并读取按钮列表

steps.expression: (() => { const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=actionItem]')); const fbItems = items.filter(i => { const img = i.querySelector('img'); return img && img.alt === '负反馈'; }); return { count: fbItems.length, exists: fbItems.length > 0 }; })()

steps.description: 断言至少有1个负反馈按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=actionItem]')); const fb = items.find(i => { const img = i.querySelector('img'); return img && img.alt === '负反馈'; }); if (fb) { fb.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击第一个负反馈按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal') || document.querySelector('.ant-popover') || document.querySelector('[class*=feedbackModal]'); if (!modal) return { hasModal: false, options: [] }; const options = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper, [class*=option], [class*=item]')).map(o => o.textContent?.trim()); const hasBack = options.some(o => o.includes('背面')); const hasIncomp = options.some(o => o.includes('不完整')); const hasBlock = options.some(o => o.includes('遮挡')); return { hasModal: true, options, hasBack, hasIncomp, hasBlock }; })()

steps.description: 断言负反馈弹窗已出现

steps.label: seeding-negative-feedback-modal
steps.description: 截图-种草审核负反馈弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal') || document.querySelector('.ant-popover'); if (!modal) return { result: 'no modal' }; const firstOption = modal.querySelector('.ant-checkbox-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper'); if (firstOption) { firstOption.click(); return { result: 'selected option', text: firstOption.textContent?.trim() }; } return { result: 'no option' }; })()
steps.description: 选择第一个负反馈选项

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal button, .ant-popover button')).find(b => /确\s*定|提\s*交/.test(b.textContent) && !b.disabled); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.label: seeding-negative-feedback-after
steps.description: 截图-负反馈提交后状态

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；个人任务中心存在种草审核任务（含待审核子任务）
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 审核详情使用SetImageReview组件；每张图片hover显示8按钮工具栏（局部修改/替换/未知×1/裁剪/高清化/负反馈/复位/复制URL）；负反馈按钮alt='负反馈'；负反馈弹窗选项：背面/主体展示不完整/主体遮挡
riskPoints: 种草审核任务可能不存在（需通过试运行构造数据）
负反馈弹窗选项可能随PRD迭代变更
负反馈提交后可能触发重生图，影响后续审核状态
TBD双字按钮渲染：确 认/丢 弃 含特殊空格
